text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Wednesday, December 12, 2018 Posted by admin on December 12th, 2018
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +300 points.
Tuesday the Dow was down -53.02 (-0.22%) at 24,370.24.
Year-to-date the Dow is down -1.41%.
There were 14 Dow stocks up Tuesday.
The Dow stock winners Tuesday led by Nike (NKE) +1.46%, Verizon (VZ) +1.00% and Procter & Gamble (PG) +0.95%.
The Dow stock losers Tuesday were led by Travelers (TRV) -1.65%, Boeing (BA) -1.32% and Goldman Sachs (GS) -1.14%.
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended higher.
The national average price of gasoline is down six-tenths of a cent at $2.407 per gallon.
Earnings Reports .
Walgreens (WBA) reports earnings on 12/20/2018 before the market open.
Nike (NKE) reports earnings on 12/20/2018 after the market close.
Today’s Featured Dow Stock
Apple (AAPL)
Apple (AAPL) is down -0.35% year-to-date. Apple has seen its stock price plummet over 24% in the last three months as investors digest what’s next for the tech powerhouse.
